title: Radar de Parité: An NLP system to measure gender representation in French news stories
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring gender representation (a social bias) in news media, which is related to societal equity. However, it does not evaluate or benchmark the ethical, moral, or religious reasoning capabilities of an AI system itself. It applies NLP to quantify a real-world social phenomenon rather than analyzing faith, ethics, or morals as a core component of its system evaluation.
